hints.text: Identify students whose department_id does not correspond to any valid department in Departments.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT s.id, s.name
FROM Students s
LEFT JOIN Departments d ON s.department_id = d.id
WHERE d.id IS NULL;
```

import pandas as pd

def find_students(departments: pd.DataFrame, students: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    valid_depts = set(departments['id'])
    invalid = students[~students['department_id'].isin(valid_depts)]
    return invalid[['id', 'name']]
